name: Unlimit Health (formerly SCI Foundation)
summary: Supports governments in sub-Saharan Africa to treat and prevent schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted worms; known as the Schistosomiasis Control Initiative (SCI Foundation) until 2023.

spending.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/1182166/files/2025-03-31-accounts.md (Unlimit Health accounts for the year to 31 March 2025, statement of financial activities: charitable activities partner awards £5,508,285 + direct expenditure £2,777,935 = £8,286,220 of £8,816,800 total; at £1 = $1/0.783, IRS 2024 yearly average https://www.irs.gov/individuals/international-taxpayers/yearly-average-currency-exchange-rates, nine of the year's twelve months)

lines.label: Deworming (schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted worms) through governments in Africa
lines.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/1182166/files/2025-03-31-accounts.md (all charitable activities are mass deworming support; one line)
